pull_request.title: Add a controlled zero-point source for the GitHub wallet-binding test
pull_request.body:
Add a tiny, established Lean identity as a controlled source for the pnp.fun GitHub account-to-wallet claim trial. The theorem is n + 0 = n, proved by reflexivity. It is not new mathematical research and requests no contribution points.

The repository and this PR are controlled by the pilot operators. After this source PR is merged, the immutable source may be registered with zero points. Its actual PR author can post the exact public native challenge here to test the author-claim verification flow. This does not bind any outside author or establish real-world identity or Sybil resistance. Private keys remain local and must never be posted.

The repository MIT license applies to the added file. Local validation: the exact source compiled with Lean 4.36.0 in the existing pinned container, with network disabled and source mounted read-only. This ordinary compile is not a six-kernel production proof check or a native acceptance.
